entries.title: Dim the screen and enlarge the text
entries.body: Your profile page has two new settings below Appearance. Brightness goes from Full through Dim and Dimmer to Dimmest, so a tablet can go darker than its own lowest setting, and Text size goes from Default up to Largest, for reading where you cannot zoom. Both are kept on this device and apply across the app as each page opens, so there is no bright flash. Dimming is left off when you print.

entries.title: Some PDFs no longer fail to import
entries.body: A PDF could fail to import when its text, or its title, authors or abstract, contained certain invisible characters, which turned up on pages set in maths fonts. Those characters are replaced with spaces, so the import finishes.
